table contains 47. Omitted from the footer: **F260**.

## M.4 K-R1–K-R68 → multi-session harness

Every row runs in `tests/concurrency/races.kr.spec.ts` under the multi-session
harness: ≥2 real PostgreSQL sessions on separate connections, deterministic
interleaving via advisory barriers, ≥1,000 randomized schedules at concurrency ≥32.
A single-session simulation does not satisfy any row here.
